# Dave Cummings

> Frontend engineering and solutions leader. Custom websites,
> performance, SEO, and AI visibility for small businesses.

Dave Cummings has been building websites since 2008, mostly in
ecommerce. Now shipping fast, modern sites with modern AI tooling.
Based in Central Texas.

## About

- [About Dave Cummings](https://www.davecummings.co/about/): 17
  years working in tech, mostly ecommerce. React, Next.js,
  TypeScript, and Vercel. AI tooling makes it possible to ship in
  weeks now instead of months.

## Services

- [Custom Website Build](https://www.davecummings.co/services/custom-website-build/):
  Custom websites built from scratch. Fast, accessible, SEO-ready.
  Modern tooling, no theme files. Fixed price quoted after a
  discovery call.
- [AI Visibility Audit](https://www.davecummings.co/services/ai-visibility-audit/):
  Six-dimension analysis of how a business shows up in AI-powered
  search (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity). $350 flat,
  delivered in 3 business days.
- [All Services](https://www.davecummings.co/services/): Custom
  builds, AI Visibility Audits, full website audits, and monthly
  SEO retainers.
